source_claim: AlphaEvolve-style evolutionary memory should make prior ideas, rationales, and hypotheses reusable through quality-aware and novelty-aware search, not only attach proposal text to candidates
claim_boundary: This boundary records that LibreEvolve manifests can show bounded current-run proposal scoring and hypothesis evidence: versioned proposal score records, captured idea/rationale/hypothesis metadata, bounded hypothesis-index summaries, redacted text previews and hashes, outcome-linked quality signals, exact signature novelty signals, duplicate signature counts, top-record score ordering, current-run resurfacing hypothesis sources, and recent DeepResearch query terms. It does not claim semantic or embedding-backed proposal retrieval, calibrated proposal-quality models, cross-run persisted proposal tables, prompt/archive selection policy using proposal scores, benchmark-linked proposal quality validation, or hypothesis refinement loops.
